overview_description.description: Playbook is an edutainment platform that activates the power of storytelling and shared experiences to prepare women to tackle their pain points to growth through masterclasses broken down into lessons in English & Arabic led by inspirationally influential women who shattered the glass ceiling. The platform enables users to setup custom profiles, identify their skills & career goals, engage with 1000+ classes on diverse categories of interest (especially emerging professions), network with a community to crowdsource solutions to further address their pain points, immerse themselves in a gamified experience with learning goals & progress trackers. All of this is further enabled through engaged digital learning tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Playbook is a membership-based education and investment network that unlocks the leadership and financial potential of women globally.

product.name: Playbook Membership
product.description: An annual subscription providing access to masterclasses, a professional learning community, mentorship, career resources, and events for women professionals and entrepreneurs.

product.name: Masterclasses
product.description: Pre-recorded and live educational sessions led by industry professionals covering career growth, leadership, digital marketing, and entrepreneurship.

product.name: 1:1 Mentor Coach Sessions
product.description: Personalized mentorship and coaching sessions with experts in leadership, business strategy, mental health, and other professional areas.

product.name: Playbook Awards
product.description: An annual event recognizing women leaders and organizations for achievements in leadership, innovation, diversity, and social impact.

product.name: Perks Program
product.description: A benefits program offering Playbook members access to discounts, special offers, and exclusive privileges from partner organizations.
